tests.name: app boots and signals window.__sagrada.ready
real GPU renderer active (ANGLE D3D11, not SwiftShader)
tests.detail: {"renderer":"ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (0x0000731F) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)","vendor":"Google Inc. (AMD)","webgl2":true,"pixelRatio":1}
tests.repro: launch args must be exactly --enable-gpu --ignore-gpu-blocklist --use-angle=d3d11 --disable-gpu-sandbox --no-sandbox; read WEBGL_debug_renderer_info after boot.

tests.name: renderer canvas exists at viewport size
tests.repro: canvas should fill the viewport at 800x500

tests.name: loading screen is dismissed
tests.repro: boot should hide #loader within a few seconds of ready

tests.name: no uncaught page errors during boot
tests.repro: check the browser console on a normal load

tests.name: all builders completed without recorded errors
tests.repro: window.__sagrada.errors() after boot; a non-empty list means a builder threw and its geometry is missing.

tests.name: all five builder groups are present and non-empty
tests.detail: {"environment":"34 meshes/14,802 tris","glory-shell":"22 meshes/232,270 tris","facades-np":"36 meshes/329,431 tris","towers":"55 meshes/108,142 tris","interior":"109 meshes/376,904 tris"}
tests.repro: inspect window.__app.scene children by name after boot; every builder group must exist.

tests.name: no geometry contains NaN/Infinity vertex positions
tests.repro: after boot, traverse window.__app.scene and scan every geometry position attribute for non-finite values; this is the source of "Computed radius is NaN" console errors.

tests.name: window.__sagrada debug API is complete
tests.repro: read the QA contract; window.__sagrada must expose the debug API.

tests.name: the rendered canvas is not black
tests.repro: read the WebGL canvas after boot; a black frame means nothing rendered.

tests.name: splash screen with title and three entry buttons is visible
tests.repro: load / without URL params; the splash with Enter on foot / Fly over / Guided tour must be shown.

tests.name: clicking "Enter on foot" enters walk mode
tests.repro: load /, click the "Enter on foot" button; mode must become walk, splash must hide, controls must enable.

tests.name: enter-on-foot lands at the authored plaza start pose
tests.repro: enter on foot; defaultPose in src/experience.js is [84, EYE, 116]

tests.name: holding W moves the camera forward
tests.repro: walk mode, hold W for ~2 s; the camera position must change.

tests.name: eye height and ground contact are sane
tests.detail: camera y=1.66 feet y=-0.06 eye=1.72 dim=1.72 onGround=true
tests.repro: walk on the plaza; the camera must sit one eye-height above the walkable ground.

tests.name: Space jumps
tests.repro: walk mode, press Space; the camera should rise and land back.

tests.name: Nativity façade wall blocks the walker (no pass-through)
tests.detail: start=(24.09,1.66,15.63) end=(28.63,1.67,15.64) max x=28.63 z-range 15.62..15.64 mode=walk (wall inner face ≈29.98, expected stop ≈29.56)
tests.repro: setPose([24,1.72,18],[31,1.72,18]) in walk mode then hold W; the façade wall collider at x≈30.8 (z segment 15.25..24) must stop the walker.

tests.name: ground-standing apostle tower blocks the walker
tests.detail: start x=17.50 end x=20.63 max x=20.63 (tower west face 21.2, expected stop ≈20.78)
tests.repro: setPose([17.5,1.72,-21],[26,1.72,-21]) then hold W toward the Nativity apostle tower n1 at (26,-21).

tests.name: crossing porphyry column blocks the walker
tests.detail: start x=8.00 end x=10.68 max x=10.68 (column surface 11.85, expected stop ≈11.43)
tests.repro: setPose([8,1.72,14],[14,1.72,14]) then hold W into the crossing column at (14,14).

tests.name: Nativity façade door is passable (walk in from the east)
tests.detail: start=(38.0,1.7,0.0) end=(13.76,1.71,0.00) moved 24.2 m; x=13.76 (must be < 27.5, wall plane x≈30.8); y sane=true
tests.repro: setPose([38,1.72,0],[20,1.72,0]) then hold W ~5 s; the open portal must let the walker through.

tests.name: Passion façade door is passable (walk in from the west)
tests.repro: setPose([-38,1.72,0],[-20,1.72,0]) then hold W ~5 s; the open portal must let the walker through.

tests.name: Glory façade central door is passable (walk in from the south)
tests.detail: start=(0.0,1.7,53.0) end=(-0.00,1.71,28.69) moved 24.3 m; z=28.69 (must be < 42.5, wall plane z≈45.8); y sane=true
tests.repro: setPose([0,1.72,53],[0,1.72,20]) then hold W ~5 s; the open portal must let the walker through.

tests.name: walker can reach the crossing from the Glory entrance
tests.detail: pos=(0.01,1.73,2.68) after 11 s walking south→north (4.6 m/s walk)
tests.repro: from the Glory entrance at z=53 walk straight in (W) for ~11 s; you should be inside the nave/crossing (z<20).

tests.name: F toggles walk → fly
tests.repro: press F in walk mode; mode must become fly and the HUD label FLY.

tests.name: Space rises in fly mode
tests.detail: fly mode=fly, y 20.00 → 33.31 while holding Space
tests.repro: in fly mode hold Space; the camera must rise (HUD hint and README both promise Space = rise).

tests.name: Ctrl descends in fly mode
tests.repro: in fly mode hold Ctrl; the camera must descend.

tests.name: Q descends / E rises in fly mode (as documented)
tests.repro: in fly mode hold Q (descend) then E (rise); both should move the camera vertically.

tests.name: Shift boosts fly speed
tests.detail: normal 7.63 m vs boosted 28.08 m in 0.6 s
tests.repro: fly mode: hold W then Shift+W; boosted distance should be clearly larger.

tests.name: teleport() works for every TOUR stop (12 stops)
tests.repro: for each id in __app.TOUR call __sagrada.teleport(id) and compare the camera to stop.pos.

tests.name: T starts the guided tour with a caption
tests.detail: {"mode":"tour","panelVisible":true,"title":"Plaça de Gaudí","body":"Gaudí imagined a cathedral as a forest: stone trunks, a canopy of leaves, light …","index":"01 / 12"}
tests.repro: enter the experience, press T; the tour caption panel must appear with a title and body.

tests.name: tour advances between stops
tests.repro: in tour mode click "Next →"; the stop index/title must advance.

tests.name: pause button toggles to Resume
tests.repro: in tour mode during a dwell, click Pause; the button must change to Resume and back.

tests.name: Escape exits the tour to free look
tests.repro: during the tour press Escape; the tour panel must hide and free-look must be enabled.

tests.name: builder hotspots are registered
tests.detail: 35 hotspots: plaza, city, nightfall, glory-facade, glory-portal, glory-virtues, glory-dove, glory-threshold, glass-cool, glass-warm, nave-shell, transept-glazing
tests.repro: window.__sagrada.hotspots() should list the architectural labels from the builders.

tests.name: aiming at a hotspot shows the reticle label
tests.detail: active="city" title="Barcelona, around" hint="E to read"
tests.repro: aim at a registered hotspot; the reticle label must show its title.

tests.name: E opens the info card with content
tests.repro: aim at a hotspot label and press E; the card must open with a title and body text.

tests.name: Escape closes the info card and restores control
tests.repro: with the card open press Escape; it must close and movement must re-enable.

tests.name: setTime(10.35) gives a morning scene
tests.repro: __sagrada.setTime(10.35); HUD clock must read 10:21 Morning and env.night≈0.

tests.name: setTime(21.5) gives a night scene with floodlights
tests.repro: __sagrada.setTime(21.5); HUD clock must read 21:30 Night and env.night→1.

tests.name: N toggles between day and night
tests.repro: press N; the clock should jump between 10.35 and 21.5.

tests.name: night scene renders lit content (not a black frame)
tests.repro: set 21:30 and read the canvas; a black frame means the night lighting/emissive glass is missing.

tests.name: M opens the plan/minimap and it is painted
tests.repro: press M; the plan panel must open with a painted canvas, and M must close it.

tests.name: H opens/closes the help overlay and does not trap control
tests.repro: press H; help opens and movement pauses; H again closes it and movement resumes.

tests.name: P hides the interface and P restores it
tests.repro: press P; the HUD and overlays must hide (photo mode), P or Esc restores them.

tests.name: hideUI(true/false) hides and restores every overlay
tests.repro: __sagrada.hideUI(true) then (false); all UI should hide/restore.

tests.name: quality low/high changes the renderer setting
tests.repro: open Quality in the HUD (Menu → Quality at narrow widths), pick Low; stats().quality must be low and the pixel ratio must drop.

tests.name: sound control exists and toggles (audio content not asserted)
tests.detail: narrowLayout=true controlVisible=true muted false → true → false (headless audio output is not asserted)
tests.repro: toggle Sound in the HUD (Menu → Sound at narrow widths); the mute state must change and toggle back.

tests.name: HUD fits the viewport without overflow
tests.repro: at 800x500 the HUD controls must stay inside the viewport without scrollbars.

tests.name: responsive HUD layout at 800px
tests.repro: at ≤820 px the desktop nav is replaced by the Menu button; above 820 px the reverse.

tests.name: clicking the view does not break the experience (pointer-lock fallback)
tests.repro: click the canvas in headless; pointer lock is unavailable, so the drag fallback must leave the app usable.

tests.name: URL params skipSplash/mode/pos/look/time/ui are honoured
tests.repro: load the app with the documented QA URL params; mode/pose/time/UI must follow them (pose may take ~12 s to settle on a cold start).

tests.name: URL params mode=tour&tour=<id> start the tour at that stop
tests.repro: load with ?mode=tour&tour=nave; the tour must open on the nave caption.

tests.name: URL param photo=1 starts in photo mode
tests.repro: load with ?photo=1; the interface must start hidden.
